Social Media Poster (9 Platforms)
Making content can be fun, but manually posting it to every single social media platform out there sure isn't. This automation solves that problem.
In this tutorial, I'll show you how to build a powerful n8n automation that lets you post to 9 social media platforms at once using the Blotato API. Highly modular, this workflow can easily be integrated into any AI system you currently use that requires any form of social media posting, saving you tons of time.
